sections.markdown:
## B — Signs, work zones and school zones
Audience: first-time Montana non-commercial Class D applicants studying signs, work zones and school zones.
Level: introductory rule retrieval; the ordered handbook section is the coverage basis, without any invented official examination weight. Prerequisites and confusable topics: The previous sections on vehicle equipment and occupant protection; the distinction between regulatory signs that command action and warning signs that advise caution, and between school zone limits and school crossing duties.
This is a research handoff. Read physical pages thirty-two through thirty-nine as ordinary sign, work-zone and school-zone guidance. Sign meanings that depend on color plates or diagrams are carried only where the extracted text states them. Fine and penalty figures remain debt until current official values are confirmed.
